claims.text: Quinnipiac 6-8 Mar 2026 (1,002 RV): 55% said Iran did not pose an imminent military threat to the US before the military action, 39% said it did.
JURIST 9 Sep 2007: Lamberth awarded about $2.65bn (other reports $2.66bn) on 7 Sep 2007; Iran called the ruling 'baseless' and 'politically motivated'.
Diario Constitucional 24 Sep 2026: Federal Criminal Cassation Chamber upheld constitutionality of trial in absentia (Ley 27.784) in the AMIA case; no trial date set.
Cyprus Mail 4 Aug 2026: Bitar submitted report late March 2026, reportedly accusing 70; no indictment issued as of 4 Aug 2026.
CSM 21 Dec 1982: Lebanese police 19,085 killed, 30,302 wounded 4 June-31 Aug 1982.
Kahan Commission: Sharon bore responsibility for 'ignoring the danger of bloodshed' and recommended he resign.

Majdal Shams: Hezbollah spokesman Mohammad Afif denied responsibility and blamed an errant Israeli Iron Dome interceptor; HRW's Richard Weir said damage consistent with a Falaq-type rocket, possibly one that overshot a military target; calls for independent investigation (Borrell), none reported.
Reuters 9 Mar 2026: Lebanon's parliament voted 76 of 128 to extend its mandate two years, postponing elections due May 2026.
Wikipedia (citing Wilson Center): estimates of Iran's funding to Hezbollah range from $100-200m to $700m-$1bn a year.
